subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Review school subjects, times and how often we do things.
Ask and answer with When does ...? and How often does ...?
Find and correct mistakes in unit grammar.

tf.s: Art, Maths, Science is in alphabetical order.
Adam has English homework on Wednesdays.
tf.why: Correct! That is in Adam's diary.

tf.s: Adam has swimming lessons once a week.
tf.why: Adam has swimming lessons twice a week.

tf.s: 'Osamah play tennis twice a week' is correct.
The Discovery Team always have English at half past eight.
tf.why: Well done! English is at half past eight.

tf.s: Forest School is the name of the outdoor lesson in some schools in Britain.
We say: He is always busy.
tf.why: Right! The adverb goes after is.

boxes.why: A comes before M and S.
He plays on Fridays and Saturdays.

boxes.q: How often does Adam practise karate?
___ does Adam have swimming lessons? Twice a week.
boxes.why: The answer is a frequency, so we ask How often.

boxes.q: He ___ eats fish for lunch. (7 ticks)
Ahmed goes swimming on Tuesday and Friday. He goes ___.
What do you learn in Maths?
boxes.why: In Maths we learn about numbers.

mcq.q: Which list is in alphabetical order?
When does Adam have English homework?
What do we call the outdoor lesson in some schools in Britain?
What time do the Discovery Team always have English?
mcq.why: They have English at half past eight.

mcq.q: Correct: 'Osamah play tennis twice a week.'
o: Osamah plays tennis twice a week.
Osamah playing tennis twice a week.
Osamah plays twice tennis a week.

mcq.q: Rewrite with 'always': 'He eats fish for lunch.'
o: He always eats fish for lunch.
He eats always fish for lunch.
He always eat fish for lunch.

mcq.q: Say the time: I have Art at 10.15.
o: I have Art at quarter past ten.
I have Art at quarter to ten.
I have Art at half past ten.
I have Art at ten o'clock.

mcq.q: Adam plays football on Fridays and Saturdays. How often is that?
mcq.why: Two days a week = twice a week.

mcq.q: Answer: 'How often does Adam have swimming lessons?' Which answer type is right?
o: a time: at half past four
mcq.why: How often needs a frequency answer.

o: I do my homework every day.
She has Art at twelve o'clock.
mcq.why: We use on with days: on Mondays.
